use_inetd.description: Whether to run the server under inetd/xinetd (true) or as a standalone daemon (false).

addr.description: IP address to bind to. Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

port.description: UDP port to listen on for TFTP requests.

root_dir.description: Absolute path to the root directory served by the TFTP server.

timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before a client connection is closed.

max_threads.description: Maximum number of concurrent client threads (0 = unlimited).

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging to syslog for debugging and monitoring.

options.description: Additional command-line arguments passed directly to `atftpd` (e.g., `--daemon`, `--logfile`, `--bind-address`).

path.description: Absolute path to the directory to share as a TFTP subtree.

readonly.description: If true, clients can only download (read) files — writes are forbidden.

description.description: Optional human-readable note about this share (for documentation).

shares.description: List of additional directories to share beyond `root_dir`. Each entry defines a subdirectory with optional read-only flag.

use_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support (requires server compiled with IPv6 support).
